review_conclusions: Input is copied from actual typed-array internal slots before fatal UTF8 decoding; one leading BOM is counted physically and stripped explicitly; no automatic mode/version conversion.

Whole catalogs are decoded/validated before preview and again before preparation; malformed later entries, duplicate incoming IDs/NFC names, 32-entry/entry-byte/catalog-byte violations never return a partial plan.
Opaque planner-local WeakMap previews plus immutable complete metadata retain exact expectedRaw; caller resolutions are snapshotted as own data, and the final merged catalog is revalidated.

Explicit skip/replace/copy semantics are consistent: replacements retain destination ID/display name, foreign/ambiguous targets refuse, duplicate replacement target refuses, and copy IDs are reserved across both full catalogs and earlier copies.
No side-effect API, fetch, browser storage, cooperative lock, CAS, native mutation, implied Apply or replay exists in this module.
boundaries: The author32pure proof was inspected and its exact module pin checked; these8additionalcontrols are independently executed, not an E2E or full-regression run.

Duplicate JSON object property names follow existing library JSON.parse last-key semantics; the draft explicitly reuses that parser. No separate duplicate-key rejection was promised or added. Duplicate catalog identities/names are refused.

Reflective JavaScript Proxy traps can run while inspecting caller objects; the supported contract is own data from ordinary/null-prototype objects. The reviewed getter controls do not imply arbitrary Proxy trap sandboxing.

A reusable prepared preview is data only. Future controller must still bind file/owner/query/mode generation, reread exact current storage bytes, show confirmation, and pass expectedRaw through the existing lock/CAS adapter.
No real File picker, downloads, browser integration, lock/quota/storage-event races, cold reopen, native runtime, CI or manufacturer parity is established.
